title: Towel Bar 30-Inch Solid Brass Wall-Mounted | Polished Nickel | Que New Collection | Allied Brass | Towel Bar Holder Rail | Allied Brass
description:
End towel clutter and keep your bathroom towels easy to grab with a wall-mounted towel bar in Polished Nickel, which offers a softer, warmer alternative to chrome with a subtle golden undertone that suits transitional spaces. This wall-mounted towel bar (also called a towel rack, towel holder, or towel rail) is part of the Que New collection for a coordinated, matching Que New look.

Highlights:
- Polished Nickel coordinates seamlessly with chrome faucets and fixtures
- Pairs seamlessly with matching Que New hardware for refined continuity
- Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Coordinate transitional bath accessories with the Que New collection’s distinctive circular detailing—ideal for transitional bathroom hardware updates
- Choose a finish that fits your décor with multiple designer finish options, including statement colors

Specs & Installation:
- Product: Bath towel bar / bath towel rack
- Collection: Que New (transitional)
- Mounting type: Wall mount (wall-mounted)
- Center-to-center: 30 in
- Dimensions: 30 in length; 33 in width; 3 in height; 3 in projection
- Bar diameter: 0.5 in
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Included items: Towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware (#8 x 1 1/4" screws)
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
